definitions.explanation: A sturdy table or surface used for performing manual work, crafting, cooking preparation, or other hands-on tasks.

examples.japanese: {作業台|さぎょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: To line up tools on the workbench.

examples.japanese: ⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作業台|さぎょうだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (work, operation) and {台|だい} (stand, table, platform). Refers to any flat surface designed for performing work, from workshop benches to kitchen counters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作業台|さぎょうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: on the workbench
- {作業台|さぎょうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to set up a workbench
- ⟦ステンレス→ステンレス：08832_sutenresu⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作業台|さぎょうだい}: stainless steel work table
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧{作業台|さぎょうだい}: folding work table

- ワーク⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧: workbench — the English loanword, used mainly in DIY contexts
- ⟦{調理台|ちょうりだい}→調理台：24699_chouridai⟧: kitchen counter / prep station — specifically for cooking
- {工作台|こうさくだい}: craft table / workshop bench — specifically for crafting or machining
